opening.argument: The video presents an interview about support for early-stage entrepreneurs: the speaker discusses funding and financing, then describes help with business structure and advice from other experts. Those are ordinary business-service topics, not a promise of a guaranteed return. The end card’s Subscribe button and social links serve as channel engagement cues, while the description expressly states that the video was not an advertisement and that no one paid for it as of the stated publication date. Nothing in the supplied material describes a required payment, a request to hand over credentials, or a completed financial transaction. The observable content is a discussion of finding funding and getting a company running, with no claimed financial outcome for viewers.

citations.quote: I work with entrepreneurs in Switzerland and my passion is really to help entrepreneurs to excel starting at the very early stage, you know talking about funding, financing, getting the company up and running
And then we help them, to get structure, to get financing, to get advice by other experts.
This is not an advertisement nor did anyone pay for this video in any way as per the day of publication 15.5.2017.
